_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Niwe Mchezaji {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe.
Lengo lenu ni kushinda tatu mfululizo (wima, mlalo, au diagonal) pa ubao.
Pa zamu zenu, mungafwile kuchagua nambari ya mraba (0-8) mungafwile kuweka alama zenu.
Mfano, '[4]' kuweka alama zenu katikati ya ubao.
Niwe Mchezaji {player_id}, mungafwile kuwa '{symbol}', wakati mpinzani wenu ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ukubombako umulimo wa kushitisha takulingile ukupeelwa mu nshila ya cine.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} tacili cintu ca busuma. Cifwile ukuba pakati ka 0 na 8.

game_action.placed: Mwina {player_id} akabola symbol yake ({symbol}) mu seli {cell}.
